flybys.name: Apophis
flybys.story: A 340 m asteroid that will pass closer than geostationary satellites, visible to the naked eye from Earth.

flybys.name: 2001 WN5
flybys.story: A near-kilometre asteroid that slips inside the Moon's orbit.

flybys.name: 1999 AN10
flybys.story: One of the largest known objects to pass this close this century, about 1 km across.

flybys.name: 2024 YR4
flybys.story: Briefly the highest-rated impact risk ever; impact on Earth has since been ruled out.

flybys.name: 2012 UE34
flybys.story: A small asteroid that grazes past at under a third of the lunar distance.

flybys.name: 2005 YU55
flybys.story: A dark, roughly 400 m asteroid, radar-imaged in 2011, returning inside the Moon's orbit.
